INFRARED SAUNA PLAYERS

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Some reasons to choose us!

  • Do you maintain your sauna parts and appliances regularly but can’t find the right supplier that you can count on to supply you with the things you need?
  • Do you find it frustrating that you may have to contact several suppliers for different things that you need?
  • Well, stop looking and read on to learn about the only supplier you need.

InfraredSaunaParts has been supplying various sauna parts and appliances to many saunas, not only in the country, but also to many other countries. Our supplies have helped many sauna owners to keep their business because we’re able to supply them with things that other suppliers find “outdated” or unavailable.

Our facility is over 30,000 sq ft and it offers a great place for everything you need for your infrared sauna. We have all the things you need even if you’re starting a new sauna from scratch. Some of our items such as sauna covers can be customized according to your taste and others come in various selections so you can pick the ones that suit your sauna best.

One of our best selling items is our sauna players.

Many people go to the sauna to relax and rejuvenate. So it’s important to have quality players and speakers so you can play audio medias to your clients. At InfraredSaunaParts, we have Bluetooth sauna audio system, media lockers, and digita media system. These players can easily be installed by our technician and placed at any spot in your sauna.

All you have to do is check out our catalogue and pick the ones you like best for your sauna. If you can’t find anything you like or want, then give us a call and let us know. We’ll make sure we find what you’re looking for and get back to you with an update.

So why not give us a call today to learn more about other ways we can help your sauna business?
